process_type: Dual-track: (1) court-supervised marketing & sale of some/all assets on a going-concern basis, run in parallel with (2) an orderly liquidation/monetization of inventory and receivables. Both tracks proceed simultaneously, not sequentially, per the First Day Declaration.
investment_banker: Portage Point Partners (via Triple P Securities, LLC) — also serves as Debtors' financial advisor / CTO provider (Triple P TRS, LLC)
stalking_horse_status: NONE DESIGNATED AS OF 2026-09-28. The Debtors entered chapter 11 without a stalking horse bid. As of the Sept 7, 2026 bidding procedures motion, Portage Point had contacted ~105 prospective buyers, ~25 of whom signed NDAs for diligence access. The Bidding Procedures Order (Docket #219, entered 9/26/26) preserves the Debtors' ability to designate a stalking horse bidder later, with bid protections, if it would maximize estate value. Deadline to designate one is October 23, 2026 (per Cash Collateral Milestones) / October 21-23, 2026 (per Bidding Procedures sale timeline). UPDATE (2026-10-24): The October 23, 2026 4:00pm ET deadline to designate a stalking horse bidder (per the Bidding Procedures Order, Docket #219) has now passed with no stalking horse designation appearing on the docket through entry #407 (filed 10/26/26). The Bid Deadline (10/30, now just 3 days away) and Auction (11/4, if more than one Qualified Bid is received) remain on schedule per the Bidding Procedures Order. UPDATE (2026-10-31): The October 30, 2026 4:00pm ET Bid Deadline has now passed. Only routine/administrative filings (professional fee applications, a lease rejection motion, a claim stipulation, and an appellate procedural filing) were docketed on 10/30/26 (entries #415-421) — no notice disclosing bid results or a stalking horse designation has appeared yet. The next expected signal is the Auction on 11/4 (if more than one Qualified Bid was received) or a Notice of Auction Results around 11/5. UPDATE (2026-11-02): The Notice of Auction (Docket #426) confirms the Debtors received more than one Qualified Bid by the October 30 Bid Deadline. No stalking horse bidder was ever designated during this process. The Auction will proceed as scheduled on November 4, 2026 at 10:00am ET, conducted virtually via Zoom; a Notice of Auction Results is expected around November 5, 2026.

notes: The bidding-procedures process is an OPEN auction process, not a pre-negotiated sale — any Qualified Bidder can participate. This is a meaningfully more uncertain path than a case that starts with a signed stalking-horse asset purchase agreement. Per Lansio Declaration (Docket #92), if a stalking horse is later designated, it would set a bidding floor. Court-approved bid procedures order was entered ahead of its own required deadline, signaling the case is proceeding on schedule so far. UPDATE (2026-10-15): The contested October 16 final cash-collateral hearing was cancelled and resolved instead by a consent Third Interim Order (Docket #338, entered 2026-10-14), which reset the lender-driven case milestones roughly a month later across the board (plan/disclosure statement filing now due 11/14, sale-approval order and final cash-collateral order both due 11/16, sale consummation now due 12/18). This was a negotiated, consensual extension — not a default — and the Committee's and the U.S. government's reservations of rights on the cash-collateral order were both resolved as part of it. The Debtors' KERP/KEIP, and the Kirkland & Ellis and Triple P TRS (CTO) retentions, were also finally approved the same day.
